title.en: An Act Appropriating Additional Funds for the Operation of the House of Representatives for the Fiscal Year Ending June Thirty, Nineteen Hundred Sixty-Two

text.en:
The sum of three million pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated as additional funds for the operation of the House of Representatives for the fiscal year ending June thirty, nineteen hundred sixty-two, itemized as follows:
1. For settlement of unpaid obligations with the Bureau of Printing ₱500,000.00
2. For repairs and improvement of rooms and buildings 250,000.00
3. For payment of overtime services of employees during session 157,000.00
4. For expenses in connection with committee meetings 250,000.00
5. For terminal leave of officials and employees 400,000.00
6. For the payment of retirement and insurance premiums 443,000.00
7. For employment of supplementary personnel for a period of three months 450,000.00
8. For supplies and equipment 550,000.00 TOTAL ₱3,000,000.00

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, April 25, 1962.
